paragraphs.source_en: 19. [November 25, around 4 p.m. Someone phones Monkey informing him that Tamayo is in the abandoned house in Toyohata Village. Monkey goes there immediately by boat and finds Tamayo unconscious on a bed, a memo signed by "The Man in the Shadows" pinned to her chest, and Tomo tied to a chair nearby, half-naked and gagged. Monkey leaves Tomo as he is and takes only Tamayo back to the villa by motorboat sometime between 4:30 p.m. and 5:30 p.m. (All unsubstantiated---only according to Monkey's statement.)]

paragraphs.source_en: Perusing this list repeatedly, Kindaichi always felt overwhelmed by the darkest gloom each time he reached the last item regarding Tamayo's identity. After the case had come to an end and all its secrets had been brought out into the open, it would be found that this indiscreet revelation by Oyama, the priest of Nasu Shrine, was indeed the climax of the case of the Inugami Clan.
